text:
62세 여성 환자, Addison's disease로 인한 acute adrenal crisis로 입원.  
BP 88/54 mmHg, HR 112 bpm, RR 24 breaths/min, BT 37.0°C, SpO2 92% (room air).  
Severe abdominal pain 호소함.  
Hydrocortisone 100 mg IV STAT 투여함.  
Nasal cannula 2 L/min 적용함.  
Fluid resuscitation with normal saline 시행함.  
Foley 유지함, urine output 30 mL/hr 확인됨.  
환자 drowsy 상태임.  
Endocrinology consult함 for management of adrenal insufficiency.
